paper_message: Representative synthetic gates show interval-backed validation of normalization, OF/EMPCA geometry, colored-noise weighting, and residual calibration.
The frozen pooled analysis supports the within-channel rank-6 EMPCA hierarchy and records the negative controls and tied-linear AE consistency check.
Post-freeze equal-channel and hierarchical analyses preserve the positive OF, multi-template competitiveness, and PCA contrasts, with uncertainty limited by seven clusters.
The global PSD model fails held-out random and chronological real-noise calibration.
The PSD estimator matches GWpy exactly, while earlier score-path comparisons were diagnostic because the filters were not identical.
The audit trail separates the failed setup attempt, reproducible remote runs, and scientific gate status.
Claim-state matrix for writing control; useful for supplement or internal handoff.
Shared-FIR implementation identity passed; original GLS/FIR comparison remains a diagnostic sensitivity result.
Time-local PSD follow-up is a negative real-data result: synthetic control passed, but primary local-64 H1/L1 gates failed.
